questions.stem: A patient with chronic, refractory vasomotor rhinitis is planned for surgery aimed at reducing nasal gland secretions by interrupting parasympathetic fibers before they reach the pterygopalatine ganglion. Which of the following best describes this surgical approach?

options.label: A
options.text: Vidian neurectomy performed via transnasal or transpalatine approach

options.label: B
options.text: Anterior ethmoidal nerve block at the anterior skull base

options.label: C
options.text: Posterior nasal nerve section within the inferior meatus

options.label: D
options.text: Endoscopic cauterization of the infraorbital nerve
